title: Modeling by shortest data description
claim_supported: Description length provides a criterion for selecting model structure and parameters by accounting for the description of the observations under the model.
limitation: The coding language and model class matter. Short description length does not establish causal correctness or mechanical structure.

title: DreamCoder: Growing generalizable, interpretable knowledge with wake-sleep Bayesian program learning
claim_supported: A synthesis system can jointly grow reusable symbolic program abstractions and improve neural guidance for subsequent program search.
limitation: Reported transfer and synthesis results depend on supplied primitives and task distributions; learned abstractions do not establish uniquely correct real-world ontologies. Results were not independently replicated in this review.

title: Program Synthesis from Polymorphic Refinement Types
claim_supported: Recursive programs can be synthesized to satisfy specifications expressed as polymorphic refinement types, with specification decomposition reducing the search space.
limitation: Formal correctness is relative to the stated specification and formal-language assumptions, not a guarantee that the specification captures scientific intent; benchmark results were not independently replicated here.

title: Functorial Data Migration
claim_supported: Treating schemas as categories and instances as set-valued functors gives schema mappings canonical pullback and adjoint data-migration operations.
limitation: Canonical migrations need not be invertible or lossless; formal migration properties do not establish that schemas describe the same scientific entities or preserve every relevant query.

title: Challenging Common Assumptions in the Unsupervised Learning of Disentangled Representations
claim_supported: Unsupervised disentangled representations are not identifiable without inductive assumptions on models and data; the paper also reports a broad empirical comparison of disentanglement methods.
limitation: The impossibility result does not exclude identification using suitable supervision, interventions, or additional assumptions. Empirical results were not independently replicated in this review.

title: Interventional Causal Representation Learning
claim_supported: Interventional data enables identification of latent factors up to specified equivalences under explicit decoder, support, reconstruction, and intervention assumptions.
limitation: The principal polynomial-decoder results require structural assumptions; more general decoders require additional conditions. Identification does not imply sparse Jacobians or simple Lagrangian structure.

title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
claim_supported: Reflective prompt evolution using execution feedback and diverse candidates achieved reported improvements in held-out benchmark comparisons, with separate training, validation-score access, and test evaluation.
limitation: Results are specific to tested models, tasks, feedback functions, and budgets; they do not prove universal superiority over reinforcement learning or general scientific self-improvement. No independent replication was performed here.

title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
claim_supported: Automated-evaluator-guided code evolution produced reported algorithmic and infrastructure improvements, including exact-checkable mathematical constructions and unseen-workload evaluation.
limitation: Effectiveness depends on useful automated evaluators. Exact mathematical correctness and workload-dependent performance are distinct evidence types; infrastructure gains were not independently reproduced in this review.

title: Goedel Machines: Self-Referential Universal Problem Solvers Making Provably Optimal Self-Improvements
claim_supported: A formal self-rewriting agent can prove that switching to a candidate rewrite is preferable to continuing its current search, relative to encoded axioms, utility, environment assumptions, and computational costs.
limitation: The optimality result is conditional on the formal setup and provability; it does not guarantee that useful proofs or rewrites can be found within practical resources.

title: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
claim_supported: Mechanisms that restrict information released from adaptively queried holdouts can provide statistical generalization guarantees under explicit sampling and query conditions.
limitation: Guarantees require the specified mechanism, assumptions, noise, and budgets; repeatedly exposing exact validation scores does not inherit them.

title: Diagonal arguments and cartesian closed categories
claim_supported: In a cartesian closed category, a weakly point-surjective morphism from A to Y^A implies that every endomorphism of Y has a fixed point.
limitation: The theorem requires its categorical hypotheses and does not establish dynamical attraction, stability, conservation, a mechanical substrate, or physical realization.

title: Über formal unentscheidbare Sätze der Principia Mathematica und verwandter Systeme I
claim_supported: Incompleteness constrains sufficiently expressive formal systems under explicit effectiveness and consistency hypotheses.
limitation: The result does not imply that bounded program verification or useful scientific prediction is impossible; application to a proposed system requires establishing the relevant formal hypotheses.
